enGB: Weapon Proficiency (firearms)
The Weapon Proficiency (firearms) feat allows you to use all firearms without penalty.
Rapid Reload

The time required for you to reload a firearm is reduced to a move action (for a one-handed firearm), or a standard action (two-handed firearm). Reloading a firearm still provokes attacks of opportunity.

If you have this feat you may fire an advanced firearm as a full-attack action.

Whenever a fighter {g|Encyclopedia:Attack}attacks{/g} with a weapon from this group, he gains a +1 {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g} on attack and {g|Encyclopedia:Damage}damage rolls{/g}. This group includes all crossbows and firearms.
